victor_recovery.title: Victor – automatic recovery
victor_recovery.description: Optional reload of the selected existing Victor integration after sustained unavailability. Defaults: wait 20 minutes, at least 60 minutes between attempts, maximum 3 attempts per outage. HA startup/retry and reauthentication are respected. One stale or unavailable trap alone does not reload a healthy account. Reset attempts manually if needed; the cooldown remains.
